epics.title: Standalone Responsive Knowledge Base & Fast Search Tool
epics.jtbd: When an educational resident, researcher, or faculty member accesses the CRIE knowledge base on desktop or mobile, I want a fast, thoughtful, self-contained search and document exploration interface without third-party integration friction, so that I can immediately find and inspect clinical, academic, and normative resources in seconds.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Visual parity delta < 0.01 against approved design mockup
epics.tocConstraintRef: frontend/src/App.svelte rendering fidelity and responsive styling
requirements: R1: Implement pixel-perfect design refresh in frontend components matching the approved mockup design/approved/20261109090510-mockup/mockup.html with full responsive layout and WCAG 2.1 AAA contrast compliance
R2: Verify interactive controls, search filters, and topology presentation across mobile and desktop breakpoints without layout shift

slices.title: Apply approved design mockup styling and layout refresh to frontend components
slices.jtbd: When implementing design mockup alignment for this epic, I want to update App.svelte and UI styling to match the approved 20261109090510-mockup asset, so that visual parity, responsive layout, and contrast standards are fulfilled in the production interface.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the approved mockup at design/approved/20261109090510-mockup/mockup.html,
When the frontend components in frontend/src/App.svelte are updated and rendered,
Then the DOM structure, typography, dark palette tokens, and layout sections match the approved mockup pixel-perfect.
Given interactive controls for search filters and navigation on desktop and mobile viewports,
When user interactions and viewport resizing occur,
Then elements maintain WCAG 2.1 AAA contrast ratios and respond without layout shift or broken button handlers.
slices.tocConstraintRef: frontend/src/App.svelte visual styling and component layout
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% automated visual regression pass rate across desktop and mobile viewports
